kb_proposals: A binder `(T : TopologicalSpace E)` is a LOCAL INSTANCE: inside a structure/def/theorem quantifying over a second topology, `inferInstance`, `IsOpen`, `𝓝`, `≃ₜ`, `Deck p`, `IsRegularOn`, `IsBranchedCovering` all silently elaborate against T. Name the natural topology (`abbrev weakTopMax := SpreadEnd.instTopologicalSpace`), put every weak-topology notion in an auxiliary def outside the T-context (`IsRegDevelopingOnReg`, `deckMapsMax`), and prove T-facts through a predicate-level engine with no T in context (`exists_isOpen_subset_of_strongPred`).

Maps into an open subset with its induced structure: `isAEMorphism_of_val_comp` (V : Opens N) reduces IsAEMorphism of f : P → V to that of val ∘ f; with `opensHomeoRestrict` it gives restrictions of isomorphisms of opens (GXScaffold.SingularII.Models).

A second topology T on a type with an instance: name the instance in the binder ([tN : TopologicalSpace N]), put every hypothesis about the natural topology BEFORE the binder (T), and after it use @-forms or a helper def taking the instance explicitly (@deckMapsOf N M tN q); ‹TopologicalSpace E› fails for global instances — use (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace E).

Gluing topologies given locally: TopologicalSpace.mkOfNhds on a chosen local nhds filter (GX.glueTop, GX.nhds_glueTop) — if the local topologies are open on their pieces and agree in nhds on overlaps, the glued nhds are the local ones; then first countability, local path-connectedness (GX.hasBasis_isPathConnected_of_nhds_eq), portliness (induced topologies equal, GX.induced_eq_of_nhds_eq, then isPortly_iUnion_of_local) and continuity transfer by rewriting nhds (GXScaffold.SingularII.Models).

@-application makes strict-implicit binders explicit: `@IsOpen.inter_closure _ T _ _ h x hx` (⊆ is ∀ ⦃a⦄); `@Continuous.isOpen_preimage`/`IsOpen.preimage` synthesize the local second topology — use a helper stated outside the T-context (isOpen_preimage_base_weakTopMax).

Sub-coverings: the library has no lemma that an intermediate covering E → N of a Galoisian maximal covering E = M̃^S → M is Galoisian (deck-transitive on singular fibres); the paper uses it silently (RamcovGX.tex:2025, 2093) and lem:spread_top / theo:local_virt_tame both need it — build it first in any package touching strong topologies.

For a trivial group, a singular manifold whose maximal atlas has one chart defined on all of reg is rigid: any two a.e. morphisms into it agree (GX.eq_of_isAEMorphism_of_subsingleton) — a cheap non-vacuity witness for rigidity hypotheses (S² of ex:eucl_sphere).

Cheap non-vacuity witness with a rigid singular point AND singular points carrying non-extendable local symmetries: ℂ with the a.e. structure pulled back by z ↦ z + z⁻¹ on ℂ ∖ {0, ±1}, G trivial (devStructure); 0 is a pole (unbounded, injective nearby ⇒ rigid), ±1 branch points with the local flip z ↦ z⁻¹ (GXScaffold.SingularII.Models, section Joukowski). Pattern: for G trivial a chart of the maximal atlas equals the developing map on the regular set (joukowski_chart_eq), and IsAEMorphism.eq_of_eqOn propagates agreement from one open set.
